name: Card back
prompt: Create one abstract CARD BACK for the Francis Bacon-inspired dark tarot deck. Use the attached image as a style reference only: deep black void, bruised violet and blackened oxblood, raw rubbed and scraped canvas, vertical paint streaks and a few sickly ochre or chalk-white flickers. An exactly 180-degree rotationally symmetric two-way design: two opposed gestural abstract human silhouettes enclosed within two opposing fine wire ellipses and a single central dark diamond. Equal visual weight at both ends, no top-only horizon. Isolated shapes feel unsettling and fragile, abstract rather than literal injured bodies. Keep two thirds near-black, no gore, no words, numbers, signature, watermark, beige or gold ornamental border. Full-bleed near-black edges, portrait 3:5, highest resolution, one flat card back.
